name: Shackles of Ellswyn
source:
Shackles of Ellswyn is A futadom and chastity focused visual novel where you are a university student sucked into an alternate world of dominant, well-endowed women who each want you to be their personal pet.

[From [url=https://twohotmilfsstudio.itch.io/shackles-of-ellswyn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《埃尔斯文的枷锁》是一部以二元性和贞操为主题的视觉小说，你是一名大学生，被卷入了另一个世界，里面有占主导地位、天赋异禀的女性，每个人都希望你成为她们的私人宠物。

[来自[url=https://twohotmilfsstudio.itch.io/shackles-of-ellswyn]Itch.io[/url]]
